title: Build a padel club app
prompt: Build a booking app for a padel club.
about: The stage-2 big job: a wide product on ready-made foundations (storage, sign-in, courts, slots, prices, wallet, layout). 13 independent modules: bookings, member area, public pages, waitlist, notifications and calendar, blocks, coaches and lessons, tournaments, staff admin, reports, pro-shop, staff rota, each in English and Portuguese. A wide job with a shallow chain: the honest best case for many agents.
starter: scripts/lab/scenarios/club/starter (foundations in lib/, modules/ empty, the brief in README.md, 3 tests)

profile.dependencyChain: foundations (in the starter) -> 13 modules, each on the foundations only; waitlist, calendar and reports also read bookings/lessons -> depth 2 at most
profile.note: qb5 first guesses; modules are separate files loaded automatically, so shared files are rare. Target: ~60 min for one Opus agent; measured after the Oct 12 reset

anchors.note: reference built after the 2026-10-12 13:00 UTC reset (weekly meter)
